vulnerability_summary: Zeptoclaw Android device_shell blocked only literal rm flag spellings and allowed equivalent argument permutations.
causality: Human atomic commit 92396b57 added device_shell(), including literal lower.contains checks for rm -rf and rm -r. Claude-coauthored commit e7c1a68d changed clipboard handling, URL schemes, numeric casts, mutex behavior, and tests; it left device_shell's vulnerable blocklist unchanged. Squash 8f1c1db4 combines those trees and carries the Claude trailer, but the vulnerable lines map to the human atomic commit. Fix 68916c3e replaces them with flag-aware parsing.
